data.exclusions: Historical ID-only exclusion union plus every discovery/confirmation ID reserved by the concurrent geometry study; no held-out outcome read.

planning.final_score: Original frozen E0 only; no best-visited sample

ablations.abl_context_jev: Remove current-image nearest16 prefilter; rank all256 endpoints by the same frozen Jev head and take4. All subsequent planning unchanged.
ablations.abl_rank_none: Keep nearest16 current-image prefilter; select4 uniformly without replacement using a separate seeded RNG instead of goal ranking. No learned head. Two planner seeds; no fictitious head replication.
ablations.abl_direct_jev: Use25 residual knots from the first trajectory stage instead of5; run the same two T-iteration stages and retain the same9 final means. Same original branch, proposal population and scoring calls. Isolates coarse-to-fine parameterization against direct full-resolution search.
ablations.abl_retain_jev: Compute exactly the full main method including all9 costs, then disallow the four coarse trajectory means at final selection. Keep original CEM mean plus four fine means. Same search cost; this isolates coarse-incumbent retention, not speed savings.

statistics.primary_endpoint: 50-command environment success; average heads/planners inside each root, then equal weight tasks. All 9 pairwise comparisons, all signs, all tasks retained.

method_definition.teacher: sigmoid((observed squared-distance B-goal minus A-goal)/training mean distance)
method_definition.student: Identity-initialized 192x192 metric; half observed BCE plus half mean forecast BCE (5/15/25), identity penalty .001; frozen historical final checkpoints
method_definition.teacher_information: RGB/recorded actions/frozen encoder and predictions only. No preference API or success label for the main guide.
method_definition.deployment: Current-RGB prefilter; student endpoint ranking; unchanged coarse-to-fine residual optimizer; original goal cost for elites/final selection.
method_definition.observed_only_control: At exact identity the observed-only self-distillation BCE is minimized because teacher and student logits coincide, with zero identity regularizer. Thus the geometric guide is the exact observed-only solution; no artificial duplicate fit.

qa.parity: Frozen RefinementSolver vs default generalized solver for all four guides, plus original CEM branch; exact 0
qa.source: First fixed training record, never evaluation-root selection
